**nano.md 0.2.0 — easier reading of long plans and specs**

Find, navigate and size long documents without leaving the rendered view.

- **Find in the preview:** `Ctrl+F` searches the rendered text without
  switching to the editor. Matches are highlighted, and Enter /
  Shift+Enter scrolls to each one. In the editor, find works as before.
- **Headings menu:** the button next to View / Edit lists the document's
  headings (levels 1–3). Click one to jump to it, in the preview or the
  editor.
- **Reading size that sticks:** the `Ctrl+=` / `Ctrl+-` / `Ctrl+0` zoom
  level is remembered across restarts, and the Aa menu on the toolbar
  shows it and lists the shortcuts.
- **Welcome page:** starting nano.md without a file, before you've opened
  any, shows a short page with the shortcuts that matter.

**Install:** download the archive for your platform below;
`SHA256SUMS.txt` covers all of them. Binaries are still unsigned, so
SmartScreen and Gatekeeper warn on first launch; the README's Install
section covers both.

**Platforms:** Windows x86_64, macOS arm64 and x86_64 (real `.app`
bundle), Linux x86_64 (glibc 2.35+, built on ubuntu-22.04).

Full changelog in [`CHANGELOG.md`](https://github.com/odysseia06/nanomd/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md).
